display.purpose: Introduces a task workspace or history view.

title.purpose: Holds the current question or task focus.

label.purpose: Separates provenance and compact metadata from reading copy.

motion.name: typing-pulse
motion.purpose: Indicates that an assistant response is in progress.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The one clear action for a focused work area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid #111; border-radius: 3px; background: #111; color: #fff; font: 500 13px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #333; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #175dc1; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #111; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A compact route control with a clear active state.
components.html: ChatExamsResources
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 180px; } .ds-nav-item { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 4px; color: #555; font: 400 14px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #eee; color: #111; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #175dc1; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: #111; color: #fff; }

components.name: Chat Composer
components.description: The compact, uninterrupted prompt field used to begin a study exchange.
components.html: <form class="ds-composer"><input class="ds-input" aria-label="Ask a question" placeholder="Ask a question…"><button class="ds-send" type="button" aria-label="Send question">→</button></form>
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; gap: 8px; width: min(100%, 720px); padding: 7px 8px 7px 14px; border: 1px solid #cfcfcf; border-radius: 5px; background: #fff; } .ds-input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; color: #111; font: 400 14px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-composer:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #175dc1; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-send { width: 31px; height: 31px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #111; color: #fff; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-send:hover { background: #333; }

components.name: Document Card
components.description: A clear record of a study source and its current indexing state.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 14px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid #dedede; background: #fff; color: #111; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge { display: grid; width: 40px; height: 28px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #aaa; color: #555; font: 400 10px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 5px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #666; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card code { display: block; margin-top: 6px; color: #888; font: 400 11px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; }

components.name: Question Option
components.description: A high-clarity answer choice that exposes selection without excessive color.
components.css: .ds-option { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 13px; border: 1px solid #aaa; background: #fff; color: #111; text-align: left; font: 400 14px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option:hover { border-color: #111; } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #175dc1; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-option.ds-selected { border-width: 2px; border-color: #111; background: #f1f1f1; } .ds-letter { display: inline-flex; width: 38px; height: 24px; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #999; border-radius: 50%; font: 400 11px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Study Assistant is a quiet, utilitarian workspace that keeps learning actions close at hand. The interface earns its sense of completeness through predictable navigation, consistent controls, direct language, and visible system feedback rather than decorative flourishes. The visual field stays intentionally spare: paper-white work areas, a slightly warm rail, near-black actions, and thin gray boundaries. Information is organized like a well-kept desk: a stable place for tools, a clear working surface, and only the cues needed to complete the next study task.
keyCharacteristics: Quietly utilitarian controls with high contrast actions.
Compact, dense layout that protects reading and working space.
Clear status, selection, error, and progress feedback.
IBM Plex Sans for approachable utility; IBM Plex Mono for provenance and metadata.

rules.name: The Color-Has-a-Job Rule
rules.body: Color must communicate focus, completion, or correction. The neutral palette carries the rest of the interface.

rules.name: The Reading-First Rule
rules.body: Larger type introduces the current task; small mono and uppercase labels only identify supporting context.

rules.name: The Stable Tools Rule
rules.body: Navigation stays visible while the task surface changes; responsive layouts preserve that orientation before adding more density.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use a border, tonal shift, or explicit state treatment to separate content. Do not add decorative shadows.

dos: Do use Desk Ink for the one clear primary action in a working area.
Do use 1px dividers and contained backgrounds to structure information.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus with the 3px Focus Blue outline.
Do state loading, success, error, and selection in direct, compact language.
Do use IBM Plex Mono for source, file, model, and keyboard metadata.
donts: Don't introduce decorative gradients, shadows, or oversized display treatment.
Don't use color as ornament; reserve it for focus, completion, correction, and destructive actions.
Don't obscure orientation on small screens: keep the product name and main navigation available.
Don't add large corner radii to ordinary controls or cards.
